strings.ho-mcq.prompt: What is the main idea of the first paragraph?
strings.ho-mcq.explanation: The first paragraph describes a change: working from home has gone from an exception to a common option, and opinions about it are divided.
strings.ho-mcq.why.b: The text says the opposite: many companies offer at least part of the week at home.
strings.ho-mcq.why.c: The paragraph does not mention abolishing home working at all.
strings.ho-mcq.why.d: It is about employees in general, not only managers.
strings.ho-tfng.prompt: True, false or not stated in the text: "Wer im Homeoffice arbeitet, spart Zeit und Geld."
strings.ho-tfng.explanation: True: whoever does not have to commute every day saves time and money (second paragraph).
strings.ho-tfng.why.f: The paragraph says explicitly that time and money are saved.
strings.ho-tfng.why.ng: This is stated explicitly in the second paragraph.
strings.ho-order.prompt: Put the topics in the order in which they appear in the text.
strings.ho-order.explanation: The text moves from the introduction through advantages, drawbacks and the companies' side to a recommendation (hybrid working).
strings.ho-headings.prompt: Match each paragraph with the heading that fits it.
strings.ho-headings.explanation: A heading has to cover the main idea of the paragraph, which is usually in its first sentence.
strings.ho-cloze.prompt: Choose the connector that fits here (watch the word order).
strings.ho-cloze.explanation: "deshalb" is an adverb that introduces a consequence and takes the verb in second place ("deshalb klagen manche …"). Obwohl, indem and falls send the verb to the end.
strings.rv-mcq.explanation: The second paragraph names traffic jams, bad air and scarce parking spaces as reasons, and lists the advantages of the bicycle.
strings.rv-mcq.why.b: The text only mentions closing some streets, not a general ban on cars.
strings.rv-mcq.why.c: The cost of the bicycle is not given as a reason; the text stresses space, air and health.
strings.rv-mcq.why.d: The text does not say this; it speaks of more and more cyclists.
strings.rv-tfng.prompt: True, false or not stated in the text: "Radfahrer müssen in allen Städten einen Helm tragen."
strings.rv-tfng.explanation: The text says nothing about helmets, so the right answer is "not stated".
strings.rv-tfng.why.t: No such obligation is mentioned anywhere.
strings.rv-tfng.why.f: The text does not claim the opposite either; it simply does not talk about it.
strings.rv-order.prompt: Put the topics in the order in which they appear in the text.
strings.rv-order.explanation: The text begins with the change, goes on to reasons and measures, turns to the parking dispute and ends with the outlook.
strings.rv-headings.prompt: Match each paragraph with the heading that fits it.
strings.rv-headings.explanation: A heading has to cover the main idea of the paragraph, which is usually in its first sentence.
strings.rv-cloze.prompt: Choose the word that fits here.
strings.rv-cloze.explanation: "allerdings" is an adverb that adds a reservation and leaves the word order alone. Obwohl, indem and falls introduce a subordinate clause with the verb at the end.
